name: Wagend Infra Venture Limited
about: Wagend Infra Venture Limited engages in investing activities primarily in India. It focuses on exploring opportunities in the infrastructure sector. The company was formerly known as Agarwal Holdings Limited and changed its name to Wagend Infra Venture Limited in May 2012. Wagend Infra Venture Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
